front: How are the radius and diameter related?
back: $d = 2r$, so the radius is half the diameter.

front: Which is the longest chord of a circle?
back: The diameter (the chord that passes through the centre).
Part of the curved edge (circumference) of a circle.
The whole curved edge of a circle: the distance all the way around.

front: Why is a triangle made of two radii and a chord isosceles?
back: Both radii of a circle are the same length, so the triangle has two equal sides.
Half of a circle, cut off by a diameter.
